assumptions: All graphs and digraphs are finite and simple unless the statement explicitly says otherwise.

definitions.definition: An edge coloring in which incident edges receive different colors.
A proper edge coloring with no path or cycle of four edges whose edges use only two colors.
The minimum number of colors in a star edge coloring of G.

domain.description: Finite simple undirected graphs G with maximum degree Δ(G) ≤ 3.

quantifiers.domain: finite simple undirected graphs with maximum degree at most 3

statement.text: For every finite simple graph G with maximum degree at most 3, is the star chromatic index χ′ₛ(G) at most 6?

title: Star chromatic index of subcubic graphs
